title: fix(plugin-form): the modal and drawer record forms save a picked permission-set holder's package; pin the create form's seed rules
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao3XDFkGrTRqQfj2akN67XAJ)_

Fixes #32833

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：弹窗和抽屉里的「新建授权」表单，选了某个包的权限集后，保存时现在会把这个包一起存下来（以前显示选中了，保存却只存名字）；另外给分页、分步表单的种子规则补了界面级测试，给几处规则补了注释。
- 为什么改：两个包提供同名权限集时，用户在弹窗/抽屉里选的包被悄悄丢掉，授权落到的不是用户选的那一份；整页、分页、分步表单早已正确，只有这两处漏了。
- 风险与回滚：只在新建、只对授权对象、只在用户改动过包时才多存这一列，条件与整页表单完全相同；服务端照旧校验并拒绝不持有该名字的包。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/writePayload.ts`（新的 `createWritePayload`）、`ModalForm.tsx` / `DrawerForm.tsx` 的新建分支、`__tests__/objectFormPermissionRefEdges-32795.test.tsx` 末尾三段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormPermissionRefEdges-32795.test.tsx`，预期 29 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Item 6 (arm: the modal and drawer forms carry the pick the same narrow way the record form does).** Measured on `main` `75102c80` first: in `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` on a grant's create, a package holder's option is pickable (the form renderer hands the widget its create-only writer and the section builder stamps the object), and the save drops the picked `permission_set_package`, because those two forms spelled their own create payload (owner pick, then the runtime-default omission) without the holder step. The record form's create step is now one function, `createWritePayload` in `writePayload.ts` (module-internal, not a package export), which `formWritePayload` calls and the modal and drawer forms call for their create. They keep their own create test (`mode === 'create'`) and their own definition, so nothing else they send changes. No new channel, no new string.
- **Item 1.** Rendered saves for `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm`: a seeded package is not shown and not sent; a package the user then picks is sent.
- **Item 2.** A comment on `FormWriteSources.createBaseline` and on `seedCreateValues` states the invariant (a create's values and its baseline come from one call). Pins: an unnamed definition's seed keeps the package and the save still sends the name alone, unit and rendered (tabbed, wizard); a baseline built by a second seed would turn the seed into a pick.
- **Item 3.** Pins: `withFormObject` keeps an author-written `formObject` when there is no object name or no reading widget, and the form's stamp wins when present; an action param (`permissionSet`, never stamped) lists package holders disabled and a click writes nothing.
- **Item 4.** Comment on `FORM_OBJECT_KEY`: a field-definition key, not the app shell's URL parameter of the same spelling (`RECORD_FORM_OBJECT_PARAM`). No rename.
- **Item 5.** Comment on `rowHolderPackageFieldOf`: without the package column, a shared name shows the last-served holder's label; display only.
- **One holder (CONTROL).** Modal and drawer: a one-holder pick writes the name alone.

## Tests

All new pins sit in the existing shared harness files as top-level `describe`s:
`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormPermissionRefEdges-32795.test.tsx` (items 1, 2, 6, CONTROL) and
`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RegistryRefField.permissionRefEdges-32795.test.tsx` (item 3).

- Item 6 premise, measured on `main` `75102c80` before the fix: the two "a package holder is pickable, and the save writes the holder's package beside the name" pins (ModalForm, DrawerForm) were red, the 19 others green: `Tests  2 failed | 19 passed (21)`.
- After the fix, that file: `Tests  29 passed (29)`.
- Every ui test file that imports what this diff changes (`ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, `writePayload`, `schemaDefaults` in plugin-form; `permissionSetHolders` anywhere): `Test Files  27 passed (27)`, `Tests  347 passed (347)`.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, the test project covers `src/**/*.test.tsx`) for `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/fields`: exit 0, 0 errors each, after a declaration build of `@object-ui/plugin-form^...`.
- eslint over the 7 changed source and test files: 0 errors (warnings only, the existing `any` in test harnesses).

## Acceptance notes

- The order's stop line ("if any change widens what a form sends") was read against the card's own arm for item 6: the modal and drawer creates now send `permission_set_package` exactly when the record form's create does (`createHolderPackagePayload`'s conditions unchanged: create only, grant object only, a declared column, a value the user changed against the opening values, field-level security applied). Nothing widens beyond the record form, and the server's verdict is untouched.
- `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` do not apply `formWritePayload`'s inline-members rule (a non-empty `customFields` still sanitizes against the object definition there). That difference predates this PR and is left as is; routing them through `formWritePayload` whole would change it, which is why only the create step is shared.
- Item 5's label is unchanged behaviour (display only), commented, not changed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (item 6): revert the modal and drawer change ⇒ its pin goes red</summary>

Fix committed first (`ab8ae5ff`). Mutation: `git restore --source=75102c80` of `ModalForm.tsx` and `DrawerForm.tsx` only, under a trap that restores them from `HEAD`. Landed on disk: `createWritePayload` count modal=0 drawer=0, `createOwnerPayload(payload` count modal=1 drawer=1.

- Ablated run: `Tests  2 failed | 19 passed (21)`; the two failures are exactly the ModalForm and DrawerForm "a package holder is pickable, and the save writes the holder's package beside the name" pins. The one-holder CONTROL, the environment-set pick and the seeded-package pins stayed green.
- Restore: `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty; blob hashes on disk equal `HEAD`'s (ModalForm `0641e46c`, DrawerForm `02ada934`).
- The subject resolves from `src` (plugin-form tests import `../ModalForm` relatively), so no build sat between mutation and run.
</details>
